answer: Use a rotating public beacon to audit agents at random: each epoch it selects a sample that must prove recent useful work plus a small time-locked deposit. New identities start below a trust ridge with strict rate limits, and only rise after passing repeated audits over weeks. A Sybil operator must therefore pay verification, deposit-locking and work costs for every fake identity in every round, while honest agents pay once. The audit trail, carried like a raven's message between verifiers, makes copied or idle identities easy to spot and revoke.
